question.text: If frequency of electromagnetic wave is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>60</mn><mo> </mo><mi>MHz</mi></math> and it travels in air along <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi></math> direction then the corresponding electric and magnetic field vectors will be mutually perpendicular to each other and the wavelength of the wave <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mi>in</mi><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is :

solution.text:
As speed of electromagnetic wave is given by, c=fλ. Therefore, 

λ=cf=3×10860×106=5 m.
